THE APPROPRIATION ACT, 1957
THE APPROPRIATION ACT, 1957
ACT No. II OF 1957
(For Statement of Objects and Reason see Gaz. of P., dated the
20th February, 1957, Ext., p. 398.)
[4th
March 1957]
An Act to authorize payment and appropriation of certain
sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of the
financial year 1957‑58.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of
the financial year 1957-58.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:------
1. Short title------This
Act may be called the Appropriation Act, 1957.

Issue of Rs.9288510000 out of Federal Consolidated Fund for 1957-1958

THE APPROPRIATION ACT, 1957
THE APPROPRIATION ACT, 1957
ACT No. II OF 1957
(For Statement of Objects and Reason see Gaz. of P., dated the
20th February, 1957, Ext., p. 398.)
[4th
March 1957]
An Act to authorize payment and appropriation of certain
sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of the
financial year 1957‑58.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of
the financial year 1957-58.
2. Issue of Rs.9288510000 out
of Federal Consolidated Fund for 1957-1958-------From and out of the
Federal Consolidated Fund there may be paid and applied ums not exceeding those
specified in column (3) of the Schedule amounting in the aggregate to the sum
of rupees nine hundred and twenty‑eight crores, eighty‑five lakhs
and ten thousands, towards defraying the several charges which will come in
course of payment during the financial year 1957‑58 in respect of the
services and purposes specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

Appropriation

THE APPROPRIATION ACT, 1957
THE APPROPRIATION ACT, 1957
ACT No. II OF 1957
(For Statement of Objects and Reason see Gaz. of P., dated the
20th February, 1957, Ext., p. 398.)
[4th
March 1957]
An Act to authorize payment and appropriation of certain
sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of the
financial year 1957‑58.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of
the financial year 1957-58.
3. Appropriation-------The
sums authorized to be paid and applied from and out of the Federal Consolidated
Fund by this Act shall be appro priated for the services and purposes expressed
in the Schedule in relation to the said year.
